functional_requirements.title: Digital claim submission
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit an expense claim digitally, without paper or email.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates the value proposition's 'digital submission' capability.

functional_requirements.title: Single approver dashboard
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall present every pending claim awaiting an approver's decision in one dashboard view.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Restates Phase 1's 'single approver dashboard' roadmap item as a testable capability.

functional_requirements.title: Submission-to-payment time reporting
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall record, per claim, the elapsed time from submission to payment, and expose this for reporting against a target of under 5 business days.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates NSM-01's metric and target.
